title: Add landing-classification test convention to defaults.toml
summary: Add one new [[default]] entry to defaults.toml (version bump per proposal convention only if required) that applies to jobs changing how land or reconcile classifies commits (pr_commits, GitLandingRecords). It requires a test on a realistic branch history and the full athena-core and athena-cli suites, reconcile included, passing before handover. Audience: the readers/verifiers who derive acceptance criteria from defaults.

defaults_applied.how: The new entry is explicitly marked prose-only, since no loop code detects such jobs.
Criteria require running cargo test, not checking that the entry exists.
Entry text is self-explanatory to an outside reader.
Independent verifier runs the test suites.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: applies_to is ["*"] because the trigger is the job's subject (land/reconcile classification), not a class of work; the statement scopes it.
Source cites this user request, as other entries cite a job or BRIEF section; no specific job id is known, so cite 'user request 20261024-170205-dnqd'.
defaults.toml is a governance file and is named as a deliverable; athena.toml needs no change.
The existing parse tests in admission/run_pin_tests continue to load defaults.toml unchanged in schema.

acceptance_criteria.text: defaults.toml gains exactly one new [[default]] entry with a unique id, statement, applies_to, and source; no existing entry is altered.

The statement requires, for any job changing how land or reconcile classifies commits (pr_commits, GitLandingRecords), a test against a realistic branch history containing operator or intervention commits, commits with no trailer, and commits not attributed to any job.
The statement requires the full athena-core and athena-cli test suites, reconcile tests included, to pass before handover, and is explicitly marked prose-only if no mechanism enforces it.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core -p athena-cli`: all tests pass, showing the modified defaults.toml still parses (DefaultsModel::parse, admission and run-pin tests).
Only defaults.toml changes; the diff (git diff) shows no other file touched.

out_of_scope: Changing land or reconcile code itself
Building mechanism that detects such jobs automatically
departures: Small single-file config change, so cost and time are lower than the reference; test suites run cold add some time.
